repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Hold · 2026-11-28T05:11Z · source: maintainer ruling (Tesla, 2026-11-28 05:07Z, project thread "评估建工作区定制包"): 「立专题卡，暂停」.

Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/runtime dist-tags.latest` answers 19.x (19.0.0 or later). At filing it answers 18.6.0; next is 19.0.0-next.2.

Reason: 19.0.0 is being prepared. The topic opens a door (nothing in it needs the major), and the first whitelist entries are the two most protected identity tables, which should not move before a release. The restart condition is the seat's reading of that reason; the maintainer named none, and the assessment thread tells him so.

On restart: the seat asks the maintainer once whether to open M0, then files only M0's children (milestone table in the body). No child is filed while held. Past 30 days unrenewed, the seat asks once; no renewal closes the parent not_planned.

Owed outside the hold, before 19.0.0: ADR-0146:574 says the next version opens the kernel whitelist. If 19.0.0 ships without it, that sentence needs a dated note moving the whitelist to 19.x (Tier H, the maintainer merges). A comment here records it when it lands.
